original_value: This ultra secure iStorage diskAshur2 portable hard disk drive features real-time AES-XTS 256-bit hardware encryption with your own unique 7-15 digit PIN. The super fast USB 3.1 features transfer speeds of up to 148MB/s (read) and 140MB/s (write), and is also compatible with USB 2.0. Water and dust resistant (IP56 certified), the drive also features an epoxy coated, wear resistant keybord.
